title: hazbrief evidence record (DN-010 D3)
description: One record per activity that produced an evidence entity: an MCP tool call (written by hazbrief.evidence.client.RecordingClient) or an upstream exchange (the seed, scripts/migrate_exchanges_to_store.py). Field names are W3C PROV-O's where PROV has one (startedAtTime, endedAtTime, generatedAtTime as as_of, used, wasRevisionOf); provenance_class and horizon_s are DN-009 C1's. The model never writes a record (DN-010 D5): narrated_by_model is not a provenance_class here.

entity.description: prov:Entity. sha256 of the canonical JSON of the response body (hazbrief.packs.canonical_json), or of the raw bytes for a body that is not JSON.

activity.description: prov:Activity. `id` is sha256 of the canonical activity without `id`, so a second call is a second id.

name.description: the tool name, or `GET <api>` for an upstream exchange

params.description: the request parameters; for an upstream exchange, {method, url} with the url as recorded (credentials removed)

http_mode.description: the server's HAZBRIEF_HTTP_MODE: a replayed live source is not a live read

is_error.description: an MCP error result (a structured error, DN-003 s1, is a record like any other)

name.description: as the server named itself on the channel the activity used: the MCP serverInfo name for a tool call, the User-Agent product token for an upstream exchange

tool_surface_sha256.description: null for an upstream exchange, whose recording named no surface

reported.description: the MCP initialize handshake's serverInfo as sent (its version is the framework's, so `version` above is the package's)

source.description: prov:Organization(s): the catalog rows (docs/sources/catalog.yaml) the activity read.

provenance_class.description: caller_supplied: a value the request gave, with no source behind it (DN-010 ADDENDUM-00); labels carry it as a source of a tool call. narrated_by_model is never a record (D5).

as_of.description: prov:generatedAtTime of the source value: the source's own timestamp when it gives one, else endedAtTime

horizon_s.description: from the catalog; the shortest horizon among the sources read; null when every source is `computed`

horizon_source.description: the catalog row the horizon is taken from

used.description: prov:used: entity hashes this activity read

wasRevisionOf.description: prov:wasRevisionOf: the activity id this record corrects (DN-010 D2)
